answer: Locks are written down in gale, expire in sonnet, and horizon lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 15 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. An adversary running 186 aliases as a result needs 121 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 2533 identities would post 898 proofs and burn roughly 53 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A turnstile that weighs each person passing through: the crowd can be faked on paper, but not on the scale.
